thread:
neal: Heads up: canary LCP for dashboard jumped from 1.1s -> 2.6s at ~09:10 UTC. Noticed large JS parse on cold loads. Anyone on call? :frowning:
tara: I saw the alert. Quick trace shows increased bundle download + parse. Network shows a new 320kb chunk pulled during initial render.
li: That chunk looks like `analytics-logger` from the custom telemetry work (PR #1589). It was lazy before but a recent change bumped it into a shared chunk used by metrics tiles.
kevin: We changed splitpoints last night to reduce waterfall depth; seems we accidentally merged analytics into shared-viz. Oops.
neal: perf-bot: metric snapshot attached -> main-thread-block: +1.5s, first-contentful-paint: +0.9s, bundle-download: +0.35s.
perf-bot: (automated) Canary deviation > 3 sigma for LCP on /dashboard.
tara: Quick logs from a repro session: ```
[09:11:02] GET /static/js/shared-viz-4f8.js 304 312kb
[09:11:02] eval shared-viz -> 430ms main-thread
[09:11:02] parse analytics-logger 180ms
[09:11:04] render tiles start -> blocked by parse 900ms
```
li: Also saw backend telemetry: route affinity changed around same time due to a routing-policy rollout (steering to dedicated eu-west pool). That increased cache shard spread for prefix keys. KV hit for tile-keys fell 94%->78%.
kevin: So two orthogonal regressions aligned: bigger client chunk + server-side prefix cache misses = much worse tail LCP.
neal: Emergency mitigation: revert the splitpoint change to keep analytics lazy and roll routing-policy to previous weights. Shall I trigger?
tara: Yes please. Also can we hotfix client to defer analytics init with idle callback until after paint? Low-risk patch.
kevin: Deploy-bot: revert frontend splitpoint change (deploy id fe-rollback-88) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: revert routing-policy canary weights to prior config (id route-rollback-12) :white_check_mark:
li: After revert telemetry shows LCP trending back down within ~90s. KV hit-rate recovering to ~93%.
neal: Filing follow-ups: 1) add a splitpoint review checklist (verify chunk size + shared deps); 2) add a canary gate on dashboard LCP + KV hit-rate when changing routing weights; 3) add a small telemetry panel that surfaces bundle changes per deploy.
tara: I'll open the splitpoint PR to keep analytics lazy and include a unit test to ensure analytics isn't bundled into shared-viz. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/frontend/pulls/1592
li: I'll add the routing canary metric check to the rollout infra config.
kevin: Also let's add a small client-side guard: if shared chunk > 200kb mark it for conditional load and warn in logs. Could help catch accidental merges earlier.
neal: Good. Assigning: @tara for PR, @li for routing gate, @kevin for chunk-size guard. I'll write the blameless note for #postmortems after 30m stable.
tara: Thanks all. Closing thread. :handshake:
